setup.doneSub: Open your library whenever you like. Anything you skipped waits for you under Admin.
setup.languageNone: No language matches. English is always there.
setup.languageSub: Choose the language KROMA speaks to you.
setup.mediaFailed: This folder could not be added. Check that the server can read it, then try again.
setup.mediaHint: Each folder becomes a library. KROMA works out whether it holds films or shows.
setup.mediaLiveSub: The scan runs in the background. You can go on, it does not stop.
setup.mediaRemoveHint: Removing a folder takes it out of KROMA. No file is deleted.
setup.mediaSub: Choose the folders that hold your films and shows. The scan only reads them.
setup.modulesNone: No module is on offer right now. You find them later under Admin, Modules.
setup.modulesSub: Modules add features to your server. Your choices apply when you leave the setup.
setup.modulesTitle: What else should this server do?
setup.ownerDoneSub: The account exists and you own this server. Change your name or your email here if you like.
setup.ownerFailed: The account could not be created. Check the fields, then try again.
setup.ownerPasswordLater: You change your password under Account, at any time.
setup.ownerSaveFailed: The change could not be saved. Check the fields, then try again.
setup.ownerSub: You own this server. Everyone else gets their own account later.
setup.peopleMailBody:
Hello,

Here is an invitation to my KROMA server:
{link}

The link works once, for 7 days.
setup.peopleMailSubject: An invitation to my KROMA server
setup.peopleRightsDetail: You change the rights of an invitation from its menu. A link works once, for 7 days.
setup.peopleRightsLink: New rights make a new link. The old link stops working.
setup.peopleRightsTitle: By default, an invited person can only watch
setup.peopleSub: Create a link for each person. They choose their own password.
setup.privacySub: Once a day, your server sends an anonymous report: a random identifier, its version, its platform and how it was installed. No name, no address, no title.
setup.stageLanguage: Your films and shows, on the television, the phone and the computer.
setup.stageMedia: A scan only reads your folders. It changes nothing in them.
setup.stageModules: Add only what you will use. You can remove a module later.
setup.stageOwner: One account each, with its own Continue Watching.
setup.stagePeople: Everyone gets their own Continue Watching.
setup.stagePrivacy: No name, no address, no title.
setup.stageStart: Start empty, or arrive with everything you have watched.
setup.startBring: Bring my Plex or Jellyfin server
setup.startBringHint: Your libraries, your people and what everyone watched come with you. Your old server is only read.
setup.startFreshHint: Point KROMA at your folders and it builds your library.
setup.startSub: This only decides the next screens. You can add either one later.
setup.startTitle: How do you want to start?
